thread:
Jon: heads up — argo app-of-apps in eu-west is stalled, sync backlog growing and prune jobs are failing
ops-bot: [ALERT] argo-server eu-west: sync_queue_length=312, prune_failures=27
Sara: noticed this ~30m ago, pods stuck Terminating on several GPU nodes, autoscaler can't drain
Cheng: any obvious finalizers on the PVCs? could be helm hooks leaving jobs around
Mike: grabbing kube output now, scaling events look normal but PVs are Pending in eu-west-2-cluster
Jon: here's one of the failing prune logs:
```
error: unable to remove resource: persistentvolumeclaim/mlflow-claim-abc123 "DeleteResourceFailed: resource has finalizer kubernetes.io/pvc-protection"
```
Sara: yep finalizer on PVC + the CSI driver has a delete timeout, so argo prune retries and hits concurrency backoff
Cheng: is this the same cluster that hit the EBS quota last month? Could be region-level limits causing slow deletes
Mike: running `kubectl get pvc -n mlflow -o wide | grep Terminating` shows 12 PVCs in Terminating, 8 bound to GPU nodes
Jon: autoscaler refuses to evict pods with local ephemerals and PVC finalizers, so nodes can't be reclaimed — capacity pressure keeps growing
Sara: short-term: can we manually remove the pvc-protection finalizer after verifying snapshot/backup? Long-term: need automatic cleanup on failed helm hooks
Cheng: agree — propose a small patch to our app-of-apps helm chart to add `pre-delete` hook cleanup and a post-sync job to ensure finalizers cleared for aborted releases
Mike: also wondering if argo's prune wave window size is too small causing many concurrent prune workers to hammer the API under pressure. Might increase `--prune-workers`? but that could worsen API rate limits
Jon: we should also throttle app-of-apps fanout for clusters with known slower control planes (eu-west). smart routing for gitops syncs?
ops-bot: deployment job #4527 for infra/argocd-config applied: changes to argocd-cm sync windows queued
Sara: temporary mitigation I did: added annotation `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "100"` to mlflow app so it prunes last, reduced immediate churn, freed up 2 nodes
Cheng: thanks — can you paste the kubectl patch you used? makes audit easier
Sara: `kubectl annotate app/mlflow argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave="100" -n argocd`
Mike: for the PVCs I manually cleared finalizer on 3 non-production ones after backing up data:
```
kubectl patch pvc mlflow-claim-abc123 -n mlflow -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":null}}' --type=merge
```
Jon: fine for non-prod but we need an SRE-approved runbook for prod case. Also need to notify data-platform about snapshot policy gaps
Cheng: I'll open a PR to argocd chart to add controlled prune waves and a pre-sync hook that checks for stuck PVC finalizers, with a safe opt-in flag
Mike: I'll follow up on quota check with cloud infra — if EBS delete ops are throttled we'll need to request higher limits or move workloads to zones with spare capacity
Sara: cost note: if we can't reclaim nodes, prod GPUs keep running and costs spike. We should estimate extra hours and warn finance if outage lasts >6h
Jon: good point. Mike, can you do a quick estimate for extra GPU hours at current pressure?
Mike: estimating ~48 extra GPU-hours in last 3h across eu-west due to delayed drain. If this persists we'll hit our monthly reserved vs on-demand delta by about 4%
ops-bot: reminder: please file a post-incident with timeline once resolved — tag #incidents and include PR/rollback IDs
Cheng: PR: github.com/redwood/infra/argocd-config/pull/789 — adds opt-in safe-finalizer-cleaner hook + argocd sync-wave defaults for slow clusters
Jon: thanks. Action items: 1) Mike: cloud quota check + estimate to finance 2) Cheng: PR and runbook draft 3) Sara: continue manual mitigations for non-prod and coordinate snapshots 4) Jon: decide if we increase prune-workers or adjust API rate limits tomorrow
Sara: ping me if you need the list of stuck PVCs, I'll export it
Mike: will post quota request ticket and ETA in this thread when done
Jon: great. keep thread updated, if we hit >8h open incident channel and escalate to oncall
